newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on domestic cash market.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on domestic cash market.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on steady exports of U.S. rice and an overall firm domestic paddy market, traders said.
"Export sales continue to exhibit pretty good numbers and the cash paddy market continues firm," a trader said.
USDA Thursday said the U.S. net export sales for rice during the week ended November 28 were at 53,800 tonnes.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 700 contracts, above the 673 traded Wednesday.
Rice closed three to eight cents per bushel higher, with January up seven at $10.69 per cwt.
